title: ヒシアマ寮長の朝ご飯

text_block_list.text: One morning, in the Miho Dormitory cafeteria…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hold it there, Turbo! You're not leavin' till you eat a proper breakfast!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: No way, Jose! I've got a cool donut right here, and that's all I need!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That sugar bomb isn't a meal! Now sit your butt down and eat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day, got it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You've got to have a main dish, a side dish, and a nice bowl of miso soup in order to get all the nutrients your body needs!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I don't want that stuff! I want my donut! I like that it's got rainbow chocolate and silver sprinkles! So there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I told you to hold it—hey! Stop right theeere!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Man, she's hopeless! But I guess it's still better than having nothing at all…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Crap, I need to hurry and start my solo training! I don't have time to eat breakfast today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I think I'll just keep it simple with some toast today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Come on, guys—breakfast is important! Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Anyway, it's gettin' to be a real problem. I just want everyone in the dorm to eat a proper breakfast!
Hishi Amazon seems quite worried about her dorm residents, especially Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She won't listen! All she eats is junk with more food coloring than nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And then she acts like it's some huge ordeal to eat a couple balanced dishes instead of one big snack.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm worried that she'll randomly collapse during training if she keeps this up…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've been noticin' a lot of students following Turbo's lead and skipping out on breakfast too.
She's practically at the end of her tether. There has to be a way to solve this…
choice_data_list: What if you start offering eye-catching breakfast options?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, like the kind of stuff Turbo likes? But the food's gotta be nutritious too… What would fit the bill?
choice_data_list: How about some quick 'n' easy rice balls in fun shapes?
How about some really colorful sandwiches?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Rice balls… That's it! We can use multicolored vegetables as the filling and kill two birds with one, well, rice ball!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And if I make 'em look interesting enough, even Turbo might want a bite!
choice_data_list: You can even make cute lunch boxes with them!
You can even make cute lunch boxes with them!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Turbo won't eat anything she doesn't like the look of, but if I can make it visually appealing enough, I bet she'll scarf it all down!
The next day at the Miho Dormitory kitchen…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: These rice balls are nice and seasoned, and these are filled with meat-wrapped veggies… Top them off with seaweed sheets, and there! A perfect little bear!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that looks really cool! And tasty!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, perfect timing! Go ahead, eat as much of this as you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yippee! Can you make this for me every day, Hishiama?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I sure can! I'll make lots of different things for you to try!
The cutely-shaped stuffed rice balls go on to become wildly popular at Miho Dorm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's a good idea. The colors would give it some pop while keepin' the nutritional value!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Turbo loves food with flashy colors, so I just gotta make them look so gaudy she'll gulp them down without a thought!
choice_data_list: Then you're set! You're great at making cute food.
Then you're set! You're great at making cute food.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, cooking up breakfast is easy as pie!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I present to you my clubhouse sandwiches, made with plenty of meat and veggies. And these dessert sandwiches are made with fresh fruit!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoa, they look so pretty and yummy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: They'd better! I got up early to make them for you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You did?! Aw, thanks! I'm gonna name this sandwich the Turbo Special!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh, mission complete! Now she's guaranteed to eat a proper breakfast every day!
The generously filled, colorful sandwiches go on to become wildly popular at Miho Dorm.
